what_it_probes: Threading a multi-stage feature (recurring issues: a documented rule grammar with canonical form, month-end/DST-free next-date rules with catch-up and until, spawn-on-close with copying rules and once-only semantics, a permission rule, a v5 migration for both a JSON file format and a SQLite schema with old fixtures of every version, query fields, CLI/export/import/report/digest/timeline/db-check surfaces) through a ~6,500-line, 55-module tracker. Traps: a cross-project cached view whose documented invalidation rule a new field silently breaks (agenda/due report/digest go stale), a SQLite row cache that hides an unsaved column until reopen, a fresh-vs-upgraded schema equality check, the lossy add_months helper, rollback of a spawn inside a failed bulk transition on both backends, and visible exact-output tests that legitimately must change.
